description: The Seleucid Empire maintained one of the ancient world’s earliest organized corps of heavily armored shock cavalry. Drawing upon Persian cavalry traditions and Hellenistic military reforms, Seleucid cataphracts became among the most formidable horsemen of the Hellenistic world and could be fielded earlier than the heavy cavalry of rival kingdoms.
tooltip: Unlocks Seleucid Champion Cataphracts from the stable in the Town Phase.
